verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both displays are present, but split across lemmas rather than written as two chains. First display: angular_energy_moment is a⟨1+t_ℓ²⟩ = a(1+t_s²)+ρ_ℓ, which is the paper's a(1 + t_s² + ρ_ℓ/a) after multiplying the bracket out; dividing by v_ℓ is angular_rephasing_moments part 1, angularMean (phaseDensity a v ∘ t) = 1, and that integral is literally ∫_0^{2π}(dφ/dθ')dθ' because rate = phaseDensity/(2π) and angularMean divides by 2π; the same fact is phaseMap_fullTurn, phaseMap d (2π) = 1. Second display: integral_rephase supplies the change of variables ∫_0^1 f(θ'(φ))dφ = ∫_0^{2π} f·rate dθ', and density_times_loopA / density_times_loopC collapse the integrands to the constants a and a·t_ℓ, giving the paper's middle expression (a/2π)∫_0^{2π}(1,t_ℓ)dθ'; constructed_means is the resulting pair (a, a·m). The one rewriting is the last equality (a, a t_s) = (a, −b_s): the family theorems state the second mean as a·m and never as −b_s; the substitution m = t_s = −b_s/a is carried out only in exists_prescribed_mean_shear_loop (SmoothLoop.lean:562), which is the fixed-parameter loop without the cone condition. The two components are also two separate scalar integrals rather than one vector identity.
